name: memnotsafe-console
description: Mission Control — read-only viewer for memnotsafe run artifacts (campaign.json, attempts.jsonl, budget-ledger.jsonl, report.html). Offline, no network, no secrets.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
